title: Example accountable mobile change
objective: Replace this example objective with one observable product change. State what users should experience and what must remain unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: The requested behavior is observable through a deterministic test.
Existing mobile tests continue to pass.
No production, deployment, authentication, or billing configuration changes.

analysts.responsibility: Turn the objective into observable requirements, identify ambiguity, and map affected code without editing.
Design falsification tests and identify ways an implementation could appear correct while remaining broken.
Identify regression, security, state-management, and platform-specific risks without editing.

builders.responsibility: Produce the smallest complete implementation consistent with existing architecture.
Independently implement the contract while emphasizing defensive behavior and regression avoidance.

reviewers.responsibility: Try to falsify every acceptance criterion against the frozen diff and surrounding implementation.
Look for broken existing behavior, weakened tests, hidden state interactions, and unsupported claims.
Look for authorization, privacy, secret-handling, injection, dependency, and unsafe-side-effect defects.
